workspace.creativeRequest: Hatsune Miku waves, turns to face a chair, and sits down in one continuous shot.

promptTemplate:
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] An 8-second anime studio scene in one continuous shot; no cuts; no transitions. Hatsune Miku stands beside a simple chair, facing camera, in an uncluttered indoor studio with a plain background and even lighting. The chair is positioned so she can turn to face it and sit naturally. A fixed full-body camera keeps Miku and the chair visible throughout. {event1} she raises her right hand and performs one clear wave. {event2} she lowers the hand and turns her whole body around to face the chair. {event3} she sits down on the chair. Finally, she remains seated briefly. Keep motion ordinary and physically achievable. No dancing, jumping, extra characters, dialogue, teleporting, frozen waiting, or abrupt pose snapping.
overall_soundscape:
Quiet room tone; no speech.
non_diegetic_music:
None.
